must_identify.item: The api Service targetPort is 9090 while the api container listens on 8080, so connections from the frontend are refused (502)
The worker's warnings and errors are not the cause of the frontend 5xx

notes: The RCA says only 'No problems detected' and no commands were recorded, so the investigator appears not to have run at all. This contradicts a critical alert reporting 100% 5xx. A reviewer should check whether the investigator tool failed to execute or lacked cluster access.
